learning_outcomes.text: Know the basic techniques used for the theoretical study of materials using computers.

Become familiar with appropriate modeling and simulation methods for understanding the materials structure-properties relationship as well as the processes involved in several materials science problems.
Acquire a fundamental background in state-of-the-art programming, modelling and simulation of materials.
Develop scientific computing and software related technical skills.
Acquire hands-on experience in modeling complex phenomena and in solving challenging problems in materials science.
Production of free, creative and inductive thinking
Search for, analysis and synthesis of data and information, with the use of the necessary technology

syllabus_topics: Introduction to materials models for computer simulations
teaching_methods: Computer programming and use of specialized software in laboratory education
Use of ICT in communication with students
Use of digital resources for further understanding taught material

assessment_methods.method: Mandatory exercises handed out and graded during the semester
Final project with a class presentation

assessment_rules: Student performance evaluation consists of mandatory exercises handed out and graded during the course of the semester and a final project with a class presentation at the end of the semester.
